description: Screen a proposed name against the Registrar’s published naming criteria and search the public register for existing and similar names. Reports what the register returned and which rules the name engages. Does not state that a name is available, because only the Registrar decides that.

proposed_name.description: The proposed company name, with or without the Limited suffix.

sound_like.description: Use the Registrar’s own sound alike matching as well as exact matching.
